excalibur--excalibur-natural.description: Created by General Cigar's blenders as a smoother, longer-aged take on Hoyo de Monterrey, Excalibur is made in Honduras. The natural version pairs a Connecticut Shade wrapper with a Connecticut Broadleaf binder and filler from Honduras, Nicaragua and the Dominican Republic. Earth, leather and coffee open, softening into sweetness before pepper and spice return; a polished medium smoke.

thirds.notes: Earth and leather with coffee or espresso, and a red-pepper tingle on the tongue.
The pepper fades and the smoke settles into earth, natural tobacco and a soft, honeyed sweetness.
Pepper returns with baking spice, damp wood and a bitter coffee edge.

sources.title: Stogie Brewski – Hoyo de Monterrey Excalibur
